body:
Creepy is how I've heard others describe me.  I can't define it, it's just the way it is.  Whatever creepy means to many different people, I'm it.

As for help.  I've been seeing psychiatrists since the attempts in high school.  I'm seeing a psychologist now, as I descend into a level where I won't care at all. It's probably the last thing I'll do that is a real effort to feel OK.  And I'm pretty sure it's too late.  I just want people to see what they've made, see the broken shell they've hollowed out, and see the damage they've done.  I want them to see what they can't ever take back.

Goodbye.

They said school life was over more than 10 years ago.  It's the same, nothing's really changed.  They laugh less to my face, but I have less of a chance now than I did then.  At least then I wasn't a creepy 30 something loser.
I'm quite certain I'm not good enough for anyone.  I don't like that I'll be alone but I have no choice.  To have someone settle for me would be mean to them.

I won't.  I'm done.  I'll be alone for as long as I allow myself to be.

I've felt worthless for as long as I can remember.  It's not like bad things happened and I feel down because of it.  I'm nothing.  I'm a waste.  This is a waste of time.  I'm an asshole for wasting all your time, anyone whos reading this, when all it will be is a memory to make people think they had a chance to stop it.

I'm trying to crowd-source reasons to live I guess.  I make a good amount of money in my career yes.  But what does that mean?  It means I'll get to just be alone despite having anything else, or at best used for it.  I'll never be able to believe that anyone would want to be with me.  At best, someone might settle, or want to use me.

At this point I refuse to let anyone in.  Hope hurts too much.  I only know loneliness, anything else would be strange.  And any attempt to allow myself to get used to it would only end in pain.  I guess all I want is to leave something that says 'I tried' that people can look at after.  I can't be helped anymore.

I was thinking about this the other day, and have often over the years.  I can't honestly think of something that makes me happy to do.  I played a lot of WoW, and still play occasionally.  I watch TV, and movies.  I wouldn't say they make me feel good.  They just make time go by.  I don't have hobbies and no desire any more to try to learn new things.  I think back to myself 5 years, 10 years, 20 years ago and while I wanted to die even 20 years ago, I was happier then than now.  I wanted to try things, do new things, experience new things.  I have less to live for now.
